detaileddescription.para: The handler is called from an interrupt context such that the amount of processing to be performed should be minimized. The handler provides an example of how to handle SPI interrupts but is application specific.

briefdescription.para: Runs the Spi Slave example in interrupt mode.
Implements a design example using the Spi driver (XSpi) and the Spi device as a Slave, in interrupt mode.

detaileddescription.para: The example fills the Spi Tx buffer with the number of data bytes it expects to receive from the master and then Spi device waits for an external master to initiate the transfer. When the master initiates the transfer, the Spi device receives data from the master and simultaneously sends the data in Tx buffer to the master. Once the transfer is complete, a transfer complete interrupt is generated and the example prints the data received from the master. The number of bytes to be received by the Spi slave is defined by the constant BUFFER_SIZE in the file.

The external SPI devices that are present on the Xilinx boards don't support the Master functionality. The example has been tested with Aardvark I2C/SPI Host Adapter, an off board external SPI Master device and the Xilinx SPI device configured as a Slave. The example has been tested for byte-wide SPI transfers.

simplesect.para: The example assumes that there is a STDIO device in the system.
